---
title: "ssoossh host"
description: "Manage local sshd principal mapping, and check sshd's setup."
---

<!-- Generated by genclidocs from the cobra command tree in client/cmd. Do not edit. -->

Configures the principal mapping used when sshd asks for authorized principals via AuthorizedPrincipalsCommand, and checks that this host's sshd will accept ssoossh certificates. The mapping is managed locally and never fetched from the server.

## Synopsis

```
ssoossh host [command]
```

## Options

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--file` | string | `/etc/ssoossh/principals.yaml` | path to the local principal mapping file (YAML: local account -&gt; list of principals) |

## Global options

Inherited from [`ssoossh`](/ssoossh/reference/cli/ssoossh/) and its parents.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-c`, `--config` | string |  | path to the ssoossh config file |
| `--server` | string |  | server address including scheme (e.g. "https://example.com") assumes https if omited. |
| `-v`, `--verbose` | count | `0` | trace what the command is doing, to stderr; repeat for more (-v steps, -vv requests and files, -vvv bodies) |

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`ssoossh host check`](/ssoossh/reference/cli/ssoossh/host-check/) | Check that this host's sshd will accept ssoossh certificates. |
